title: alnaster fruticosus
intro: Alnaster fruticosus, commonly known as the alder buckthorn, is a shrub or small tree native to Europe and Asia, known for its dark green, elliptical leaves and small yellow flowers. The health benefits of Alnaster fruticosus include its use as a treatment for various gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune system, making it useful in treating conditions like fever and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of Alnaster fruticosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
